intuition: 在图谱邻接中可把握：后续 → Phase-lead compensator、Phase-Lead Compensator。
explanation: A method to design a phase-lead compensator by adding the frequency response of the cascade compensator to the frequency response of the uncompensated system, using the Bode plot to determine suitable locations for the pole and zero of the compensator.
